subject: [video] lead review of WP01/WP07: 4 fixes, all imports verified against the cache
body: Committed by the lead (do not revert): (1) probe/probe_apple.h + probe_vt.c: VTCompressionSessionCreate takes the callback and its refcon as TWO arguments (10 in all); only VTDecompressionSessionCreate takes a record by pointer. (2) sdk/sysinc/stdio.h: stderr/stdout/stdin are ___stderrp/___stdoutp/___stdinp on Darwin (_stderr is not an export; a binary importing it does not load). (3) vt/symbols.txt: CMDerivedObjectCreate and CMBaseObjectGetDerivedStorage belong to CoreMedia, not VideoToolbox. (4) probe_core/probe_main: each test now runs in a child that EXECs the probe again (--child <test> <fd>), and every field is also written to the console. WP06: your tests are reached through probe_child() too, nothing to change. Everyone: symbols.txt owners must be the image that really exports the symbol; I check them with research/verify_symbols.py before each install. Stage-0 products are built from a private copy by install/build_stage0.sh, so unfinished avc/ kern/ probe/av cannot break them.
